articles.summary: New: keep multiple AI chats on one study and switch between them from the top bar; the study workspace adds dedicated Setup, Results, and Report tabs with a shareable report URL; report highlight reels can now stitch multiple clips into a single video; the researcher chat can read your study report. Improved: reports place charts and reels inline beside the findings they support, draw on your research plan, and are easier to scan with scaled headings, numbered citations, and an evidence carousel; AI-moderated sessions resume after a dropped connection; the sidebar remembers its collapsed state. Fixed: sub-steps can be removed from the workflow outline; moderation waits for prototypes to load; device-setup speech is kept out of transcripts; background moderation hiccups no longer mark sessions as no-shows; voice defaults off outside AI-moderated studies; report evidence slideouts focus the clicked theme; new chats show their title without a refresh; teammates' studies no longer replay the research goal as a first chat message.
articles.title: August 28, 2026
